import ImbalancedChen.Part3CommonPM2FiniteFold
import Mathlib.Data.Int.ModEq

def progressionActiveLabels (d : MediumAtom) (q : ℕ) (r : ℤ) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) :=
  (activeLabels d).filter (fun z => Int.ModEq (q : ℤ) (labelProduct z : ℤ) r)

def progressionProductCarrier (d : MediumAtom) (q : ℕ) (r : ℤ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (productCarrier d).filter (fun v => Int.ModEq (q : ℤ) (v : ℤ) r)

theorem sum_progressionActiveLabels_le_divisorFold
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (q : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (F : ℕ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ v, 0 ≤ F v) :
    (∑ z ∈ progressionActiveLabels d q r, F (labelProduct z)) ≤
      ∑ v ∈ progressionProductCarrier d q r,
        tau v * tau (shiftDifference d v) * F v := by

let Fq : ℕ → ℝ := fun v => if Int.ModEq (q : ℤ) (v : ℤ) r then F v else 0
  have hFq : ∀ v, 0 ≤ Fq v := by
    intro v
    dsimp only [Fq]
    split_ifs
    · exact hF v
    · exact le_rfl
  have hfold := sum_activeLabels_le_divisorFold hd hsigma Fq hFq
  simpa only [progressionActiveLabels, progressionProductCarrier,
    Finset.sum_filter, Fq, mul_ite, mul_zero] using hfold

theorem sum_shiftResidueActiveLabels_le_divisorFold
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (q : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ v, 0 ≤ F v) :
    (∑ z ∈ progressionActiveLabels d q d.residue, F (labelProduct z)) ≤
      ∑ v ∈ progressionProductCarrier d q d.residue,
        tau v * tau (shiftDifference d v) * F v := by
exact sum_progressionActiveLabels_le_divisorFold hd hsigma q d.residue F hF

def activeLabels (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) :=
  ((d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier ×ˢ
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier) ×ˢ
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier).filter
    (fun z => d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight z.1.2 ≠ 0 ∧
      z.2 ∈ d.cleanedCommonPProgression z.1.1 z.1.2)

def labelProduct (z : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) : ℕ := z.1.2 * z.2

def MediumAtom.cleanedCommonPProgression (d : MediumAtom) (p m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier.filter
    (fun n => ¬(n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue ∧
      Int.ModEq p ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue)

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_filter (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : ι → M) :
    ∏ a ∈ s with p a, f a = ∏ a ∈ s, if p a then f a else 1 :=
  calc
    ∏ a ∈ s with p a, f a = ∏ a ∈ s with p a, if p a then f a else 1 :=
      prod_congr rfl fun a h => by rw [if_pos]; simpa using (mem_filter.1 h).2
    _ = ∏ a ∈ s, if p a then f a else 1 := by
      { refine prod_subset (filter_subset _ s) fun x hs h => ?_
        rw [mem_filter, not_and] at h
        exact if_neg (by simpa using h hs) }

section ite
variable {α : Type*} (P : Prop) [Decidable P]

section Mul
variable [Mul α]

@[to_additive]
lemma mul_dite (a : α) (b : P → α) (c : ¬P → α) :
    (a * if h : P then b h else c h) = if h : P then a * b h else a * c h := by split <;> rfl

@[to_additive]
lemma mul_ite (a b c : α) : (a * if P then b else c) = if P then a * b else a * c := mul_dite ..

/-- `a ≡ b [ZMOD n]` when `a % n = b % n`. -/
@[wikidata Q3773677]
def Int.ModEq (n a b : ℤ) :=
  a % n = b % n

theorem modEq_zero_iff_dvd : a ≡ 0 [ZMOD n] ↔ n ∣ a := by
  rw [ModEq, zero_emod, dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero]

@[simp]
theorem modEq_zero_iff : a ≡ b [ZMOD 0] ↔ a = b := by rw [ModEq, emod_zero, emod_zero]
